lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p26 - Talk about the pictures.

details: Talk about the pictures activates prior knowledge and reviews the unit vocabulary. Students identify and name the school rooms in the two rows to prepare for the listening task.
Look for accurate naming of the rooms (e.g., "Art room," "Playground") when the teacher points to them.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p26 - Listen and tick.

details: Listen and tick assesses auditory comprehension and vocabulary retention. Students listen to the audio description and tick the specific room being described.
Look for attentive listening and marking the correct box corresponding to the room mentioned in the audio.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p26 - Draw a plan of your school.

details: Draw a plan consolidates learning through personalization. Students recall the layout of their own school and draw a simple map or picture including the target rooms.
Look for recognizable drawings of specific school areas (classroom, playground, etc.) labeled or distinct from each other.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p26 - Talk about your school.

details: Talk about your school provides a fluency opportunity for oral assessment. Students present their plan to a partner or the teacher, using the sentence structure "This is the..." or "We've got a..."
Look for confident pointing to their own drawing and clear pronunciation of the room names.
